name: Axelrod culture: range of interaction
description: Axelrod 1997's range of interaction: 4, 8 and 12 neighbors, and Axtell et al. 1996's 'soup' (any site), on 10 × 10 with 5 features. The paper (averaged over its nine cultures): 3.4, 2.5 and 1.5 regions. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-25): with 10 traits 3.5, 1.9, 1.8 and 1.2; with 15 traits 22.0, 9.8, 4.2 and 1.2. Wider interaction, fewer regions; soup leaves about one culture (Axtell et al.: 1.0 at 15 traits).
